name: cookie-monster-bof
description: Collect Chromium or Firefox browser data and encryption key material from the selected Windows host.
help: This patched BOF accepts the original cookie-monster command-line switches directly. Examples: bof-cookie-monster-bof --edge, bof-cookie-monster-bof --chrome --cookie-only, bof-cookie-monster-bof --firefox, and bof-cookie-monster-bof --system "C:\Users\USER\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data\Local State" 1234. Use --chromeCookiePID, --chromeLoginDataPID, --edgeCookiePID, or --edgeLoginDataPID with a browser process PID when needed. --key-only, --cookie-only, and --login-data-only select the output; --copy-file writes retrieved files to the specified agent-side directory. With no --copy-file, completed files use Undertow's file artifact handling. The upstream decrypt.py helper is available to decrypt collected browser databases: https://github.com/KingOfTheNOPs/cookie-monster/blob/main/decrypt.py. Output may contain browser credentials and file artifacts. See docs/module-bank.md and https://github.com/KingOfTheNOPs/cookie-monster for upstream behavior and credits.
